claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the value and low price, noting you get many pairs for far less than drugstore prices.
Many customers describe the lashes as lightweight and comfortable, feeling like natural lashes.
The lashes are commonly described as dramatic, long, and glamorous while still versatile for different looks.
Reviewers report the lashes are reusable and can be worn multiple times per pair.
A few customers mention minor issues such as stiffness during application or lack of left/right labeling.
